runtime_multi_concern_rules.ordering: extraction confidence desc, then ascending concern_id
runtime_multi_concern_rules.deduplication: collapse identical concern_ids; if a parent-category and a specific concern both fire, keep the specific concern
runtime_multi_concern_rules.confidence_threshold: include a concern only at/above the extraction confidence floor (deployment-set); if none clear -> NO_APPLICABLE_CONCERN
runtime_multi_concern_rules.no_hybrid: never merge multiple concerns into an invented hybrid; each processed independently
